questions.q: The autonomy contract defines three zones. Which pairing is correct?
options: Zone 1 = gated, Zone 2 = fully autonomous, Zone 3 = coordinated
Zone 1 = fully autonomous (no coordination), Zone 2 = coordinated autonomous (acts but notifies), Zone 3 = gated (proposes, pipeline approves)
Zone 1 = read-only, Zone 2 = read-write, Zone 3 = admin
Zone 1 = dev, Zone 2 = staging, Zone 3 = production
questions.explain: The chapter defines Zone 1 as fully autonomous, Zone 2 as coordinated autonomous (system acts but notifies), and Zone 3 as gated (system proposes, pipeline approves).

questions.q: Which of these actions belongs to the gated zone (Zone 3)?
options: Schema migrations
Statistics refresh
Index maintenance scheduling
Connection pool rebalancing
questions.explain: Schema migrations are listed in the gated zone alongside production primary failover, storage tier changes, major version upgrades, and index drops on primary; the others are Zone 1.

questions.q: The deployment state bus publishes pipeline states staging, deploying, validating, complete, rolled_back. What does the autonomous agent do when state is 'deploying'?
options: It ignores the state and continues all autonomous actions normally
It blocks actions in the coordinated_autonomous and gated zones via the lock_autonomous_zones list, and replays queued actions with jitter once the deployment completes or rolls back
It shuts down all autonomous agents until a human restarts them
It promotes all actions to fully autonomous to finish them before the deployment
questions.explain: The publisher sets lock_autonomous_zones to ['coordinated_autonomous','gated'] when deploying; the agent blocks those zones and replays queued actions with jitter afterward to avoid a thundering herd.

questions.q: How does the chapter solve the autonomous/IaC drift problem where terraform apply would undo the autonomous agent's runtime tuning?
options: Terraform is forbidden from managing SQL Server configuration

A configuration ownership registry (AutonomousParameterOwnership) tracks which sp_configure parameters the autonomous layer owns; Terraform reads it via a data source and excludes owned parameters from the apply plan
The autonomous agent rewrites the .tf files after every tuning action
All sp_configure settings are moved into the autonomous agent's memory
questions.explain: The ownership registry records OwnedBy/IaCBaseline per parameter, Terraform's http data source fetches owned parameters, and the apply plan only includes parameters not in the autonomy-owned set.

questions.q: Every autonomous action — regardless of zone — is recorded where, and with what minimum fields?
options: In the SQL Server error log, with the timestamp only
In Prometheus as a metric labeled by action type
In dbo.AutonomousActionLog with ActionType, Zone, InitiatedAt/ExecutedAt, RollbackSQL, Outcome, and ConflictDetected — written before and after execution
In a Git commit message in the Terraform repository
questions.explain: The chapter calls dbo.AutonomousActionLog the immutable audit trail: every action writes a record before and after execution with zone, rollback SQL, outcome, and conflict detection.
